recognizedDialects.description: Bounded Core grammar including exactly two-part vertical polychords

unknownDialectRule: When dialect is unregistered, only exact Core grammar recognition is permitted; never assume vendor-specific tokens or reinterpret an unknown symbol. Original text remains authoritative.
registeredDialectRule: A registered dialect can only use grammar actually specified by its registry entry. Vendor application names alone never imply recognition.
renderRule: No lossy rendering; semantics must reparse identically or use original input.
